Name: Kayoko's Weapons
Author: deleted33508955
Description:
[i]This is a mod that changes up the vanilla weapon textures into something different and unique, no two weapons will ever look or even feel the same! [color=#ff0000]The way these weapons were done is a bit different compared to the vanilla style that has the 'outline' for all weapons/tools/etc and I didn't wish to use that method. So, keeping that in mind, this [u]mod[/u] [b]may not[/b] be for everyone. [/color]


[b]  [/b][u][b]Currently a work in progress, but all of the weapons will be re-textured eventually. This does not add any changes besides texture changes to the weapons.[/b][/u]



[center][color=#e69138][u][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/u][/color]

-Download this mod from here or the mirrors above
-Locate your [b]TileSheets[/b] folder (ex. Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\TileSheets)
-Be sure to [b]BACKUP[/b] your [u][i]weapons.xnb[/i][/u] incase you wish to revert back
-Replace your [u][i]weapons.xnb[/i][/u] with this version (the [u]weapons.xnb[/u] is in a folder that you will need to extract with [url=http://www.7-zip.org/]7zip[/url])
-Enjoy![/center]
